name: Coastal Comic Con
blurb: A comic and pop-culture convention at the Wilmington Convention Center in Wilmington, North Carolina.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'COASTAL COMIC CON 2027 Wilmington Convention Center, Wilmington NC March 6-7, 2027' and 'MARCH 6-7, 2027 Wilmington Convention Center 10 Convention Center Dr, Wilmington,...'

notes: Organizer confirmed as Soda City Comic Con, LLC (matches the batch note; the Coastal site's own header logo image is literally alt-tagged 'Soda City Comic Con', showing the shared company behind both brands). The dedicated guests.php page (and its #voice anchor, which is the same page) rendered only the site logo and a decorative 'SPECIAL GUEST STARS' banner image, with no actual guest photo cards, so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition rather than guessed from last year's lineup.
